method: Point coordinate taken directly from the MINOS atmospheric muon charge-ratio paper (PRD 76, 052003), which states the far detector's location to five decimal degrees; the same value already recorded on site:soudan-minos-far-detector.
name: Soudan Underground Laboratory, Level 27 (MINOS far detector, CDMS II, SuperCDMS Soudan)

summary.plain: The surveyed position of the Soudan Underground Laboratory on Level 27 of the Soudan iron mine, 705 m below ground, home to the MINOS far detector and the CDMS II / SuperCDMS Soudan dark-matter experiments.
